fields.description: KRA eTIMS endpoint path, no leading slash (e.g. `saveItem`).
fields.label: Endpoint Path

fields.description: Comma-separated required HTTP headers, or `none` for the header-less init calls.
fields.label: Required Headers

fields.description: Raw KRA request field list/schema, as documented in the VSDC API reference.
fields.label: Request Fields

fields.description: Raw KRA response field list/schema, as documented in the VSDC API reference.
fields.label: Response Fields

fields.description: `Documented` = KRA protocol known, no ERPNext-side plan yet. `Planned` = wiring designed but not yet implemented in code. `Implemented` = live in code today.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Which ERPNext doctype's save/submit event triggers this call. Blank until a wiring plan exists.
fields.label: Triggering Doctype

fields.description: ERPNext field → KRA field mapping (one per line). Blank until planned.
fields.label: Key Field Mapping

fields.description: Where the response/result of this call is persisted once implemented, e.g. doctype/field names.
fields.label: Result Storage

fields.description: Python module/function path that implements this call, once `status = Implemented`. e.g. `etims_app.etims_integration.item_submission.submit_item_to_kra`.
fields.label: Implementation Reference
